title: a finger's drag pans a touch widget, arriving as touch

interactions.name: the page's listeners work over the mirror
the finger's pan reaches the page
the gesture arrives as the touch it was
the landside browser claims the touchscreen the reader has

notes: three checks, three layers, all now held: the pan is the gesture census claiming the pad's touch-action: none; arriving as pointerType touch and the page seeing maxTouchPoints > 0 are the viewport's touch flag turning on landside emulation, with the drag replayed as the touch events the finger produced — emulation and input arriving together (P-006)
